items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And let's see, who was in this band. ... John Lewis, piano, Ray Brown, bass, Milt Jackson and Joe Harris, drums.

ctx.x: I can't remember the name of the tune.

I can't think of the name of the tune, but it'll come to me. But any way, I must have made oh, 50 recordings with Jacket, Jacques "Emanon" you know, and Dizzy also. I did some very good -- this Imanon and just all of during that era. Yeah, sure all during that era. When John Lewis was playing piano, Milt Jackson was -- and let's see who -- Ray Brown, Moody. During that era. I did practically all of his recordings. Dizzy told me that MS. WILLARD: (Inaudible) in New York there was a recording session happening all…
